notes.body: a seperate commit ? (and it is msquic ? or MSQUIC ?)

"MsQuic" is the title reported in https://github.com/microsoft/msquic, so I think it is the "official" name.

I posted this change in a separate commit, because it is not related to the VN stuff, but I'll squash the commits, if you prefer; let me know what solution do you prefer

after a check it is MsQuic

QUIC: add support for draft-ietf-quic-version-negotiation-03

Add an helper to ease of adding version fields to protocol tree
Add decoding of MsQuic version
